name: vibetail
description: Provider-neutral Vibetail venue and agent platform

scripts.build: vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && tsup apps/web/src/server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --external express --external vite --external qrcode --out-dir apps/web/dist/server --clean --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.ci: eslint apps packages --max-warnings=0 && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && tsup apps/web/src/server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --external express --external vite --external qrcode --out-dir apps/web/dist/server --clean --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/check-forbidden-runtime.mjs && node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && supabase --workdir infra db reset --local
